newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms buy 35,000T U.S. wheat-traders.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms buy 35,000T U.S. wheat-traders.

text.p: Philippine flour mills bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said on Friday.

"Philippine flour mills bought 32,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $4.13 per bushel FOB and 3,000 tonnes of western white wheat at $4.11 per bushel FOB," said one trader.
Traders said earlier a group of Philippine firms invited tenders for 65,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for November shipment.
"The rest of the bids were rejected by Philippine millers," one trader who joined the tender told Reuters.
